description: Search open internships, co-ops and student jobs. Every argument is optional and they combine; a list matches any of its values. Newest first, except that roles with the query in their title or skills, and with more of the asked skills, come first. Returns the total, a page of roles (summary, places, terms, required skills, matched, applyUrl) and nextCursor. get_roles has the full posting.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page, with the same arguments.

exclude_languages.description: Leave out roles that require these, like ["French"] for someone who only speaks English.

languages.description: Only roles that require one of these languages.

lengths.description: Term lengths in months, 1 to 24, like [4, 8].

location.description: A town ("Waterloo", "London, ON"), province or state ("Ontario", "BC"), country ("Canada"), or "remote". "Toronto or remote" adds remote roles.

majors.description: Up to 10 of the person's majors: roles asking for any of them or open to any major.

posted_within_days.description: Only roles posted in the last n days, 1 to 365.

query.description: Words that must all appear (title, text, skills, company, places): "data analyst", "rbc", "swe". Short forms like swe, ml, pm, qa work. Also "exact phrase", a or b, -word.

radius_km.description: How far around a town, in km: 1 to 500, default 50.

remote.description: Add remote roles anywhere to a location; alone, only remote roles.

skills.description: Up to 10 skills or tools, like ["python", "sql", "excel"]: roles asking for any of them, those with more first.

terms.description: Up to 6 work terms, matched within the name: ["Summer 2027"], ["fall"], ["2027"].

name: search_roles
title: Search roles
